dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Idiopathic (genetic) generalized epilepsy - new-onset generalized tonic-clonic seizure with postictal sensorimotor and cognitive deficits; the video-EEG finding of ictal body turning and head version with generalized spike-wave and polyspike discharges without lateralization is characteristic of this disorder
1. Frontal lobe epilepsy with rapid secondary bilateral synchrony (less likely given the absence of consistent EEG lateralization and a normal MRI)
2. Acute symptomatic seizure from an occult metabolic, toxic, or inflammatory cause not yet identified (workup to date is unrevealing)
3. Non-convulsive status epilepticus of uncertain etiology as the cause of the prolonged encephalopathy
